coverage_limits: Only defined implemented scopes are reviewed; future premium-plugin capabilities are not claimed.
A cluster journey is associated evidence, not proof of every possible input or combination.
Inventory-wide GET isolation does not replace valid-write authorization and role-specific probes.
Current deployment is one owning process per site data directory; M9 distributed coordination is outside current guarantees.

source_review_notes.roles_and_writes: Reviewed session/owner/editor helpers and CSRF call sites in every route-owning source. Origin enforcement is shared middleware. GET inventory probes cover anonymous/subscriber isolation; valid writing, role denial, revocation and capability actions are connected-journey evidence, not exhaustive payload permutation coverage.
source_review_notes.recovery: Reviewed allowlisted table/column parsing, pre-insert validation, transactional import and derived index rebuild. Archive checksums are corruption detection, not authenticity. Restored sessions are excluded; source and target configuration stay independent.
source_review_notes.frontend: Reviewed canonical editor and structured studio save/recovery, shared widgets and styles, public form message source/origin checks, local engagement rendering and frame masking. Actual Chrome journeys and 26 representative admin screens complement source inspection.
source_review_notes.costs: Reviewed finite parser/graph/worker/request limits, batched relationships, publication-only indexed listing/search, keyset admin/entry pages, DB-backed quotas and bounded background batches. Fixed promotion document amplification, file read bounds and content-export buffering. Limits and observations do not prove arbitrary data/configuration will fit any machine.
